root_cause_summary: An admin login endpoint began returning 5xx immediately after a release. The release changed a client-side call site to pass a parameter the handler did not accept, so every admin login threw before reaching authentication.
key_findings: Error rate on the admin login route rose from 0.2% to 9.4% within 12 minutes of the release
First error timestamp falls inside the deploy window for that release
The non-admin login route, which does not share the call site, is unaffected
Stack trace terminates in the changed call site, not in the auth layer
